title: Content Type Schema Compiler
description: Compiles the CMS-agnostic content type schema. Enforces: all content type IDs are unique, reference fields point to existing types, slug fields have unique constraints, image fields declare alt text requirements, and field names follow camelCase convention.

error_codes.CTS001: content-type-schema.json missing or invalid — required fields: types[] with id, displayName, fields[]
error_codes.CTS002: Duplicate content type ID — every content type must have a globally unique id
error_codes.CTS003: Content type has no required fields — every type must declare at least one field with required: true
error_codes.CTS004: Slug field missing unique: true constraint — slug fields must be unique to prevent URL collisions
error_codes.CTS005: Reference field points to non-existent content type — referenceTo must name a type defined in this schema
error_codes.CTS006: Image field missing alt text requirement declaration — every image field must declare whether alt text is required
error_codes.CTS007: Field name violates naming convention — all field names must be camelCase
